about: AD (TrueClock overnight, experiments A and D) registered grids, all in the pinned ORFS image of E5. E5's grid rule on every platform: per design, S0 = the ORFS config as shipped; S1 = sparser floorplan (CORE_UTILIZATION lowered by E5's points: 15 for gcd and aes, 10 for ibex); S2 = denser placement (the design's own density knob: PLACE_DENSITY_LB_ADDON + 0.20 where the design sets it, else PLACE_DENSITY at E5's value, 0.90 for gcd and 0.85 for aes). Targets = multipliers of the design's shipped ORFS period P0 on that platform, rounded to the nearest 5 ps: S0 {0.70, 0.85, 1.00, 1.40}, S1 and S2 {0.80, 1.20, 1.45}. Tags <arm tag>-<design>-<nnn> in listed order. Times in ps (the sky130hd SDC gets ns).

arms.name: T2b
arms.about: T2(b): ORFS on ASAP7 with ABC told the clock. E5's grid exactly; gcd and aes go through Yosys/ABC (SYNTH_USE_SYN=0) because their shipped config uses OpenROAD's syn, which has no ABC delay target to set; ibex already uses Yosys/ABC.

arms.name: T2a
arms.about: T2(a) and D's sky130hd arm: ORFS on sky130hd (shipped configs: gcd CORE_UTILIZATION 38, platform PLACE_DENSITY 0.60; aes CORE_UTILIZATION 35, PLACE_DENSITY_LB_ADDON 0.2; ibex CORE_UTILIZATION 50, PLACE_DENSITY_LB_ADDON 0.25; P0 1.1, 3.6, 8.0 ns). Chains: E5's rule (tags adsk-<design>-<rank>-<k>).

arms.name: DG
arms.about: D's GT2N arm: ORFS's own gt2n platform (shipped in the pinned image; GT2N ships no ibex). Shipped configs: gcd CORE_UTILIZATION 25, PLACE_DENSITY 0.35, P0 170 ps; aes CORE_UTILIZATION 30, PLACE_DENSITY_LB_ADDON 0.20, P0 350 ps. Chains: E5's rule (tags adgk-<design>-<rank>-<k>).

arms.name: C
arms.about: Descriptive control (no prediction): T2b's gcd and aes runs through Yosys/ABC without the clock target, so a change in T2b can be split into 'switched to Yosys' and 'told ABC the clock'.
